The On-One Whippet is our flagship carbon XC hardtail. With a focus on lightness and speed, the Whippet is for those who ride fast and ride far! At home on the race circuit, but capable and composed for all day expedition. Built around a 100-120mm travel fork, or, with a Selcof suspension adjusted full carbon rigid fork, that will give you maximum efficiency and weight saving. Full internal cable routing adds to the sleek looks and requires less maintenance too, while cable routing for a dropper allows you take on technical descents.
Meticulously designed profiles and shapes ensure excellent strength, ride performance, and comfort. Strictly controlled tube thickness and shapes result in a frame that is strong, responsive, comfortable, and light. Transitional ovalized D shaped tube profiles transition into box profiles along the length of the top tube and down tube. This offers increased stiffness or compliance as required in each area of the tube. Slim line D profile seat stays are compliant for comfortable. Bridgeless seat stays reduce trail chatter. The dropped chainstay and large profile bottom bracket junction maximise tyre clearance whilst ensuring stiff power transfer. Tapered headtube gives composed handling and allows for large, durable headset bearings. Cables are internally routed to ensure durability and clean aesthetic.

69.5-degree head angle for fast paced agility. Balanced front and rear centres give stability. 60mm BB drop gives agility and clearance. Balanced stack and reach figures suited to fast paced XC circuits and endurance adventures. 73.7-degree kinked seat tube for added tyre clearance and comfort. Kinked top tube maximises power and handling dynamics. Geometry designed around a 100mm to 120mm suspension fork, or suspension corrected carbon fork.

29er x 2.35" tyre clearance for wide treads. Adds comfort, capability and mud clearing. BSA 73mm Bottom Bracket is ultra-durable, creak free and easily serviceable. Stealth dropper post routed.

Frame weight: 1215g (medium)
